KEEP EXACTLY (do not reinterpret, improve, re-compose or add to): the layout grid and every zone's position and size, the background, scene, props, people, poses, crops, camera angle, lighting, colour-blocking, type hierarchy, type sizes, text positions, alignment, badges, arrows, stickers, borders and overall finish. If it is a flat graphic, stay flat; if it is a photo, stay photographic; if it is UGC / lo-fi, stay lo-fi. BACKGROUND COLOUR — MANDATORY CHANGE (the ONE thing that is ALWAYS different from the reference): replace the reference's dominant background / card colour with soft pale teal-aqua #E3F2F3 (LACALUT Sensitive brand background). Keep the same background TYPE (flat card stays a flat card, gradient stays a gradient, photo scene stays a photo scene with its surfaces re-tinted toward this colour), same texture and lighting — only the hue changes. Re-tint any panel borders, pills or outlines that matched the old background so they still sit naturally on the new one. Text colours stay as the reference unless contrast fails, then darken/lighten minimally. SWAP ONLY: (a) their product → the attached LACALUT reference packshot, placed in the SAME spot, SAME scale, SAME angle and SAME lighting as their product (if their product is held, ours is held the same way); (b) their brand name, logo and wording → the LACALUT wording below. Where a line is marked "keep", reproduce it exactly; where it is rewritten, keep the SAME size, weight, colour, case and position for the new words.

5. PEOPLE / PROPS / SCENE:
People: A person's mouth and two hands.
Pose: The person's mouth is slightly open, revealing teeth and gums. The index finger and thumb of each hand are positioned at the corners of the mouth, gently pulling the lips back to expose the gums and teeth fully.
Expression: Neutral, focused on displaying the oral cavity.
Crop: A close-up shot of the lower half of a face, from just below the nose to the chin, with the hands framing the mouth. The background is out of focus.
Props: None beyond the hands.
Camera angle: Straight on, eye-level with the mouth.
Lens feel: Clear, sharp focus on the mouth and hands, with a shallow depth of field blurring the background.

8. MOOD / FINISH:
Lighting: Bright, even, and soft, suggesting a studio environment. Highlights are present on the teeth and lips, indicating direct but diffused light.
Contrast: Moderate to high, providing clear separation between the white teeth, pink gums, and skin tones. Text is sharp against the white background.
Photo vs render: High-quality photographic image for the central visual. The overall ad is presented as a screenshot of a digital article.
Any filter or grain: Clean, crisp, and natural. No discernible filters, grain, or heavy post-processing effects.
